import type { Command, RunResult } from '@argvia/core'
import { argument, defineCommand, run } from '@argvia/core'
import { runMain } from '@argvia/node'

function expectType<Value>(value: Value): void {
  void value
}

const command: Command = defineCommand({
  args: [argument.string('action', { required: true })],
  run({ args }) {
    expectType<string>(args.action)
    // @ts-expect-error 核心包推导的上下文不包含未声明参数
    expectType(args.missing)
    return args.action
  },
})

expectType<Promise<void>>(runMain(command))
expectType<Promise<RunResult>>(run(command, { argv: ['ready'] }))

// @ts-expect-error 进程适配器只接受核心包创建的命令
runMain({ name: 'unregistered' })
